title: Conditional expectation of a component
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses, let $J$ and $S$ be sets of coordinates, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the product space, and let $x$ be an outcome. The conditional expectation over coordinates outside $J$ of the $S$-component of $f$, evaluated at $x$, equals that component at $x$ if $S\subseteq J$, and equals zero otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space with positive coordinate weights summing to one
$f$ is real-valued on the product space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $J,S\subseteq[n]$, $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and $x\in\Omega$. Then $E_J(f_S)(x)=f_S(x)$ if $S\subseteq J$, and $E_J(f_S)(x)=0$ otherwise.
